plan.learningTopic: 清晨暖侧光下的长阴影、米白粗糙灰泥的反射与纹理表现，以及建筑立面中窗列、立柱和信号灯的尺度比例与接触关系。
requestedChanges: 输出尺寸设为 1024×768，使用 seed 90101。
environment.wallColor 设为米白偏暖，groundColor 设为路面灰，horizon 略低以露出底部一小段路面，texture 提升以近似粗糙灰泥。
三扇竖向窗等宽等高、水平排列，保持立面尺度一致，避免机械平铺的玩具感。
深色立柱置于立面左侧，行人信号灯通过 attachment 与立柱连接并朝正面。
light 设为清晨暖侧光，使用较低 elevation 与适中 warmth、intensity，形成统一的长阴影观感。
camera 保持建筑正面构图，使三窗完整、墙基与底部路面接触自然。
unknownRequirements: 真实长投影阴影的精确几何、方向与长度；当前仅能以低角度统一光照和明暗衰减近似。
照片级粗糙灰泥的微观凹凸与随机颗粒；当前仅能以 roughness、texture 和共享外观统计近似。
行人信号灯若需具体人形图案或文字，当前不支持任意图形/文字生成，仅能表现信号灯形体与颜色。

generation.semanticEvaluationScope: Independent checks against frozen expected constraints, using declared scene parameters, resolved attachment centers, inherited visibility and camera transform only. No image recognition, occlusion verification, photorealism score, or complete-prompt judgment.

photoQualityGate.reason: Rendered candidates, API success, numeric scene constraints and model critiques do not establish photographic realism.

provider.deduplication: Real requestId; ID-less copies are consolidated only within the same operation context/index with identical request metadata. Their global identity is not verified.
provider.elapsedScope: Sum of itemized provider request durations, not wall-clock time; concurrent jobs overlap.
provider.costScope: Actual token/call evidence only; no invoice or monetary charge was supplied.

operations.scope: Application operation durations include provider/transport work; do not add them to provider durations as separate cost.

scheduling.authoritativeStatus: Per-category and per-case final task reports
scheduling.overlapRule: A driver exit 2 caused by an existing-batch refusal is a scheduling duplicate. It does not overwrite another process's category report or turn learning_ready into failed.
scheduling.limitation: No learning driver log is consumed here; only observed per-case duplicate errors are counted. No exit code is invented.

dataSplitAudit.interpretation: Original validation/test numbers are historical diagnostics of the frozen pre-online model. They are not a new held-out evaluation of any updated model. Exact-source overlap compromises that source as a future untouched holdout; heuristic dHash matches require review.
limitations: Canonical source identity and byte SHA detect known copies, not every capture/scene identity.
dHash Hamming <= 7 follows the exploratory offline grouping heuristic and can flag unrelated low-detail images; it is not proof of duplication.
No detected intersection does not establish independence. New online observations have no frozen train/validation/test assignment.
Semantic browsing or inspection may expose a held-out source even when it was not committed to shared statistics.

learningMechanisms.onlineScope: Online ten-round learning updates linear-RGB moments and four Gaussian-band RMS amplitudes. Per-reference Gaussian fits remain separate previews.
